exemplars.description: How a government service picks metrics, sets baselines and decides what change in a number means.

why.tripwire-usefulness: Every metric is paired with the decision it informs.
why.evidence-weight: Data is the reason, not decoration.

exemplars.description: Service level objectives: a numeric threshold over a window, and what happens when it is crossed.

why.tripwire-usefulness: Thresholds over windows that trigger a stated response.
why.decisive: A target is one number, not a range of hopes.

exemplars.description: The pitch: problem, appetite, solution, rabbit holes and no-gos, written so a team can bet on it.

why.decisive: A pitch commits to an appetite and a shape.
why.evidence-weight: The problem statement is the reason, stated first.

exemplars.description: Thirteen plays, each one imperative sentence followed by a short checklist and key questions.

why.decisive: Each play is a direct instruction.
why.evidence-weight: Checklists back each play without restating it.

exemplars.description: The decision record: context, decision, status and consequences, kept short and immutable.

why.evidence-weight: Context is the evidence; the decision is one paragraph.
why.decisive: Records state a decision in full sentences in active voice.

exemplars.description: A short ranked list of values with a stated order for resolving conflicts between them.

why.ranked-focus: The ranking is explicit and used to break ties.

exemplars.description: Fourteen points, each a short imperative with its reason one click away.

why.ranked-focus: Items are distinct and individually actionable.
